requirements.requirement: Appropriate turn-signal onset before lateral movement from marked lane
requirements.source: NRS 484B.223(1)(b); Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

requirements.requirement: Target-lane surrounding vehicle gap and motion for safety assessment
requirements.source: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

requirements.requirement: Two clearly marked same-direction lanes and selected one-way layout
requirements.source: Both conjunctive prerequisites before lane movement.
